name: N-methyl-L-α-amino acid to ammonium
summary: A 4-step route from N-methyl-L-α-amino acid zwitterion to ammonium, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: N-methyl-L-amino-acid oxidase
reactions.equation: an N-methyl-L-amino acid + O2 + H2O = an L-alpha-amino acid + formaldehyde + H2O2

reactions.name: L-amino-acid dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: an L-alpha-amino acid + NAD(+) + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: an L-alpha-amino acid + cholate = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + H2O
reactions.equation: an L-alpha-amino acid + cholate = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + H2O

reactions.name: an L-alpha-amino acid + taurocholate = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + taurine
reactions.equation: an L-alpha-amino acid + taurocholate = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + taurine

reactions.name: N(6)-methyl-lysine oxidase
reactions.equation: N(6)-methyl-L-lysine + O2 + H2O = L-lysine + formaldehyde + H2O2

reactions.name: N(alpha)-methyl-L-tryptophan + O2 + H2O = L-tryptophan + formaldehyde + H2O2
reactions.equation: N(alpha)-methyl-L-tryptophan + O2 + H2O = L-tryptophan + formaldehyde + H2O2

reactions.name: glutamate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-glutamate + NAD(+) + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: carbamoyl-serine ammonia-lyase
reactions.equation: O-carbamoyl-L-serine + H2O + H(+) = pyruvate + 2 NH4(+) + CO2

reactions.name: glycocholate + an L-alpha-amino acid = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + glycine
reactions.equation: glycocholate + an L-alpha-amino acid = an N-choloyl-L-alpha-amino acid + glycine

reactions.name: an L-alpha-amino acid + acetyl-CoA = an N-acetyl-L-alpha-amino acid + CoA + H(+)
reactions.equation: an L-alpha-amino acid + acetyl-CoA = an N-acetyl-L-alpha-amino acid + CoA + H(+)

reactions.name: methylxanthine N(1)-demethylase
reactions.equation: theophylline + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = 3-methylxanthine + formaldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: glycine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: glycine + NAD(+) + H2O = glyoxylate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: pyridoxal 5'-phosphate synthase
reactions.equation: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + O2 + H2O = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + H2O2 + NH4(+)
